SELECT T1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, T3.INSITITUTE_CODE insitituteCode, T2.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, T1.NET_VALUE netValue, T1.EFF_DATE effDate, T1.VAL_STATUS valStatus, T1.REMARK remark, T1.SEQNO seqno FROM MST_BANK_NETVALUE T1 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T2 ON T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T3 ON T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T3.CUSTOMER_ID
AND T3.INSITITUTE_CODE in
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T1.VAL_STATUS = #{valStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T1.EFF_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startEffDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endEffDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by T1.EFF_DATE desc,T1.VAL_STATUS desc

SELECT DISTINCT T2.INSITITUTE_CODE id, T.CUSTOMER_NAME text, T.CUSTOMER_ID object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T2 ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID
T2.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE='12'
and (T2.INSITITUTE_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR T.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )

SELECT T2.INSITITUTE_CODE code, T.CUSTOMER_NAME shortName, T.CUSTOMER_ID object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T2 ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID
T2.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE='12'
AND (T2.INSITITUTE_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR T.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

SELECT T2.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, T2.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T1 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T2 ON T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T1.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE='12' AND T1.INSITITUTE_CODE = #{insitituteIode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T2.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, T2.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T1 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T2 ON T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T1.CUSTOMER_OBJ_TYPE='12' AND T1.INSITITUTE_CODE like '________'||#{insitituteIode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'_'
